name: David Zeleny
headline: Strategic Account Director, LPQ cert. | Ex Shopify, Universal Music, Bravado, Sony Music
about: Results-oriented Customer Success Leader / Account Director whose management experience in loss and safety intelligence, e-commerce, branding, sales & marketing, events, and merchandising drives the identification of creative opportunities & solutions for generating revenue. Proven ability to exceed client expectations, manage multiple complex projects at one time, and develop or improve work flow systems for increased productivity.

experiences.description:
• Successfully managing a book of 40+ strategic, key accounts valued at $1.5 Billion.
• Managed the largest account in region.
• Lead and host Partner Tuesday program, connecting 3P app partners with Shopify staff on a weekly basis.
• Lead Merchant Success craft on-boarding sessions for new hires.
• Consistently receive "High Positive" (the highest review) rating during impact reviews.
• Have led multiple other projects improving internal process, and merchant experience. 
• Drafted regional OKRs for merchant success. 
• Provide mentorship through internal Buddy Program, while also providing leadership vacation coverage for our team.

Reported to Director of Bravado and Vice President of Commercial Affairs. Account Manager for over 50 different clients. Accountable for logistics and execution of concurrent complex merchandising projects from concept through production and delivery.  Completed analysis of high-profile pop-up shops, tour projections and planning. Sourced and negotiated contracts with vendors and freelancers. 

• Account Management: Accelerated sales growth by 1000% from years 1 - 2, and another 100% increase from years 2 – 4. Expanded client base by 500%.
• Event Management: Managed planning and execution of Kanye West’s 5th highest grossing pop-up shop globally. Event Management: Managed planning and execution of The Weeknd’s top grossing pop-up shop globally. Also managed shops for: Imagine Dragons, Guns N Roses, Billie Eilish, Elton John.
• Cost Reductions: Reduced merchandising sourcing costs company-wide (domestically) by approximately 30%

Reported to President. Accountable for everything creative for the company including re-branding updated logo, website, and all creative assets. Developed clear strategies, and marketing toolkit. Oversaw industry trends and new product research and sourcing.

•	Streamline: Restructured workflow process, increasing efficiencies and maximizing client satisfaction. 
•	Event Management: Planned and executed trade show strategies and booth production. 
•	Engagement: Increased web traffic by 300%. Accelerated conversion rates by 50%.
•	Cost Reductions: Re-negotiated vendor rates for savings of between 5-20%.

Reported to one of the two Partners.  Managed the agency’s two largest accounts (Alliance Films/eOne, and E&J Gallo Wines).  Conceptualized and pitched strategic campaigns to clients for both large scale and low-budget projects. 

•	Business Development: Secured and negotiated partnerships with MTV, Arts & Crafts Records, Universal Music, and more. 
•	Campaign Management: Produced cross-country experiential campaigns. Supervised community management of eOne’s channels (over 250,000 followers at the time). Planned and executed fully integrated campaigns for The Hunger Games, contributing to it being the 4th  highest grossing in Canada film of 2012. Spearheaded fully integrated campaign for GOON, contributing to it winning Golden Box Office prize.
•	Account Management: Maintained Apothic Red’s #1 sales position through effective account management (agency side).

Reported to Director of Marketing. Acted as project lead for assigned roster of artist accounts, overseeing marketing, communications, and all strategic initiatives. Provided support to directors and managers. Coordinated marketing, communications, logistics.

•	Coordinated communications, logistics and execution, and reporting of lifestyle marketing campaigns (including the leveraging of various social media platforms) throughout Canada.
•	Researched, presented and reported upon new and innovative lifestyle marketing ideas. 
•	Communicated with international partners for the sourcing, scheduling and overall tracking of new licensed and distributed releases. 
•	Responsible for the internal communication of detailed weekly priority reports to various departments on behalf of the Lifestyle team. 
•	Provided AVLA (Audio/Video Licensing Association) with licensing clearances.

•	Provided administrative and creative support to A&R and Red Ink Marketing departments; given the responsibility of  coordinating marketing initiatives surrounding the Josh Ritter tour; including interviews, ticket giveaways and meet and greet 
•	Assisted during press and promotional opportunities; was recognized for in office efforts by being asked to accompany and assist marketing managers on press days with such artists as Boys Like Girls, Editors, Peter Bjorn and John
•	Scouted and reported upon domestic bands and artists. 
•	Fielded all general enquiries from artists and other industry professionals. 
•	Created and maintained detailed and organized databases for A&R and Marketing Managers. 
•	Wrote detailed biographies and album reviews for new release and media servicing.
